payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP where state dp[j][i] is max sum using j intervals among first i possible positions; iteratively fill using previous row, optimized to 1D array.
payload.rationale: The DP uses two dimensions: number of intervals (j) and index of interval start (i). Although implemented with 1D arrays, it fundamentally computes a 2D table, matching dp_2d_state.
